inputTensor.command: owner-required YOLOX preprocessing command that resizes/letterboxes, converts RGB/BGR as required, scales, and writes 1x3x640x640 float32 tensor
inputTensor.notes: This file is local owner evidence and is not committed until license and size are approved.

sampleRunEvidenceFailureReasons: owner must replace owner-required hashes with real SHA256 values
owner must capture YoloVision sample run log and SHA256
validator must pass before real-model-runtime promotion
evidence.runCommand: dotnet run --project .\samples\YoloVision -- --model .\models\yolox_s.onnx --labels .\models\coco.names --input-data .\models\yolox_s-preprocessed-fp32.bin --input-shape 1x3x640x640 --tensor-rt-line 10 --family custom --task det --layout auto --has-objectness auto --nms-mode class-aware --confidence 0.25 --iou-threshold 0.45
evidence.sampleRunCommand: dotnet run --project .\samples\YoloVision -- --model .\models\yolox_s.onnx --labels .\models\coco.names --input-data .\models\yolox_s-preprocessed-fp32.bin --input-shape 1x3x640x640 --tensor-rt-line 10 --family custom --task det --layout auto --has-objectness auto --nms-mode class-aware --confidence 0.25 --iou-threshold 0.45
expectedEvidenceLines: Profile Family=... Task=Detection Layout=... Nms=... NmsMode=...

notes: This is an example candidate manifest, not bundled model evidence.
Do not mark isSmokePassed=true until model, labels, image, hashes, output tensor metadata, and real command output are recorded.
proofClassification=build-only is non-promotable here; the example does not prove YoloVision runtime or detection quality.
The evidence sidecar may enrich a TensorRtExec build report, but it cannot promote this sample to package-consumer-runtime.
Build-only TensorRtExec output is not object-detection quality proof.
